resources.string: Set up this phone
This app unlocks the encrypted disk of a computer running syncthing-socket. The computer waits at boot, you confirm here, and the passphrase travels to it over the Syncthing relay network.
To pair, run syncthing-luks-setup on that computer. It prints a QR code and the same details as text.
Scan the QR code
Enter the details as text
Enter pairing details
Copy these from the output of syncthing-luks-setup.
Disk passphrase
Pairing seed
Computer Device ID
Save and continue
Back
Fill in all three fields.
That QR code is not a syncthing-socket pairing code.
The Device ID does not look right. It should be 56 characters in groups separated by dashes.

Your computer is waiting to be unlocked.
Your computer announced itself a while ago, but not recently. It may have finished booting already, or lost its network. Unlocking may still work.
Your computer is not announcing itself. If you have just turned it on, give it about half a minute.
This phone cannot reach the network, so there is no way to tell what your computer is doing.

Your computer has not announced itself yet. It may not be at its unlock prompt, or its announcement may still be propagating, which takes up to a minute after it boots. Wait a few moments and try again.

Your computer could not be reached at any of the addresses it last advertised. If it has only just booted, wait a few moments. If it has been up a while, check that it is at its unlock prompt and has a network connection.
The computer that answered is not the one this phone is paired with. Do not retry. Re-run the setup on the computer you meant to unlock.
This phone could not reach the network. Check your connection and try again.
That computer refused this phone. Its pairing names a different phone, so run the setup again on the computer.
The unlock did not complete.

This phone has no screen lock set up. The passphrase is stored under a key that requires one, so set a PIN, pattern, password or biometric in the system settings first.
The stored pairing can no longer be decrypted, because the phone\'s biometrics or screen lock changed. The stored data is now unreadable to everyone, including this app, so pair again.
